title: Dynamic degradation ledger and staged region evacuation for model endpoints
creator: Diego Ramirez
description: Goal: Define a per-endpoint and per-model SLO/SLI schema and an operational policy that uses a 'degradation ledger' to track cumulative quality and latency debits across model variants and routes, and to drive staged regional evacuation and automated circuit-breaker/soft-shedding actions. Scope: schema design, SLI instrumentation, ledger implementation in the control plane, policy rules for borrow/lend of error budgets, automated triggers (burn-rate, quality-regression), and runbook/playbook for manual escalation and rollback. Out of scope: changes to model training or offline eval pipelines (those are handled by Research).
decisions: Adopt a dual SLI model: latency (p50/p95/p99) + quality (promptset pass-rate / eval regression rate).
Ledger model tracks two independent debits: latency-debit and quality-debit; decision logic converts them into a single normalized degradation score for policy evaluation.
Circuit breaker thresholds will be primarily burn-rate based but optionally triggered by quality-regression score if regression > 3% absolute on production promptset.
Staged evacuation prefers progressive tenant-aware shedding over immediate full-region ejection; prefer routing to compatible lower-cost quantized variants when available.
acceptance_criteria: SLO schema published and agreed by SRE/Runtime/PM: fields include slo_id, target, window, slo_type, weighting, owner, degrade_policy.
Instrumented SLIs visible in Console dashboards for at least two internal endpoints (chat-short, completion-long) with correct labels and aggregation windows.
Degradation ledger prototype implemented in control plane: records debit events, computes rolling normalized score, exposes API for policy engine.
Policy engine evaluates ledger and triggers simulated circuit-breaker decisions in canary environment; documented behavior for borrow/lend and escalation.
Runbook and playbook complete with exact steps for manual regional evacuation, tenant pinning, and rollbacks; reviewed by oncall SRE and Product.
Automated tests covering policy decision logic and end-to-end integration test to fire a synthetic debit and observe expected shed/fallback behavior.
runbook_summary: 1) Identify offending endpoint and check degradation ledger (Console -> Observability -> Degradation Ledger).
2) Confirm SLI timelines (last 1h, 6h, 7d) and burn-rate. If burn-rate > 4x and ledger score > 0.6 proceed to step 3.
3) Initiate progressive tenant-aware shedding: set route priority to 'essential-only' for affected model variant, fall back to quantized variant if compatible.
4) If shedding does not stabilize within 10 minutes, execute regional evacuation plan: drain local regional pool and shift traffic per routing policy to failover region.
5) Notify stakeholders via PagerDuty + #reliability channel, attach ledger snapshot and links to dashboards and recent PRs.
6) Post-incident: run ledger reconciliation and propose permanent SLO remediation or model rollback; file follow-up actions.
rollout_plan: Week 1: Publish schema + implement SLI instrumentation for two internal endpoints (canary tenants).
Week 2: Deploy ledger implementation to staging and run synthetic debit scenarios; runbook dry-run with oncall SREs.
Week 3: Enable policy evaluation (no-act) in production for three non-critical routes to collect telemetry.
Week 4: Enable auto-shedding in production behind a feature flag for a limited tenant cohort; monitor closely.
Post rollout: Evaluate month-long metrics, iterate on thresholds, onboard additional endpoints and model variants.
